mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market strength, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle periods when HOUST declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a shift to manufacturing-led growth that stabilizes economic outlook, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with declining HOUST and rising INDPRO, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month signals strong labor market expansion that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession recovery periods with PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
